name: whiteboard-defense
description: After substantial work, tells you what you should know to defend it at a whiteboard: the decisions, who made each one, and where the agent relied on its defaults.

ui.title: Interface
ui.description: rich: band above the prompt, brief pane, status entry and automatic briefs. prompt: the skill alone, as in Codex and OpenCode.

auto.title: Automatic brief
auto.description: Brief automatically after a turn that changed enough code. suggest only shows a Brief me button (no extra tokens). A project's .whiteboard/config.json overrides this.

autoThreshold.title: Automatic brief threshold (lines)
autoThreshold.description: Changed lines since the last brief needed before an automatic brief.
